Class BomImportModelObserver

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.BomImportModelObserver
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.api.spi.ModelTransformer, org.apache.maven.api.spi.SpiService
@Named("ike-build-report-model-observer") @Singleton public class BomImportModelObserver extends Object implements org.apache.maven.api.spi.ModelTransformer
Observes every file-stage model Maven reads and records reactor coordinates, import-scoped POM dependencies, and declared repositories into ModelObservations, for session-end cross-referencing by BuildReportSpy.

Maven reads dependency POMs from the local repository through the same path as workspace POMs, so this observer sees third-party <repositories> declarations too — the raw material RepositoryProvenance turns into "who asked for this repository" on a repository finding.

A pure observer: the model is always returned unchanged. This is a new-API component discovered through the maven-api-di annotation index — a separate DI container from the classic sisu container that hosts the spy, which is why the hand-off happens through the static bridge rather than injection.
